title: Sunflower Conjecture
exact_target: For each fixed number of petals, does an exponential bound in set size force a sunflower in every sufficiently large family of distinct equally sized sets?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1490 (COMB-003). CC BY 4.0.

Ryan Alweiss, Shachar Lovett, Kewen Wu and Jiapeng Zhang, \emph{Improved bounds for the sunflower lemma}, Annals of Mathematics 194 (2021), 795--815; arXiv:1908.08483v3, Section 1, Definition 1.1 and Conjecture 1.3.
